items.title: New motion
steps: Turn New motion on, then press and hold an app: it should dip under your finger and lift with a soft shadow while its menu is open.
Tap an app that is slow to open: the icon should stay dipped until the app is up, never stuck.
Swipe between pages: the active page dot should stretch toward the next one and its tail follow.
Open a sheet, a menu and an alert, and switch Market tabs: each should settle smoothly, with nothing jumping or landing in the wrong place.
Turn on Android's Remove animations, or New motion off: everything should move as it did before.

items.title: Notices in the Dynamic Island
steps: Do something that shows a notice: turn a Focus trigger on or off, or save a layout backup.
The notice should fit its text (up to three lines) and stay clear of the camera and of the fold: check the cover, the open screen and half folded.
Open Settings or a full-screen page first: the notice should fall back to a short message, not sit under the page.

items.title: Undo from the update notice
items.where: The island, after a package updates itself
steps: With Update packages in the background on, wait for a package to update by itself, or use a source that has an update.
The notice should say which package updated, with an Undo.
Tap Undo: the earlier version should come back, Home should stay as it is, and the same update should not be installed again by itself.

items.title: An install cut short
steps: Only if you are comfortable force-stopping Folio: start a package install or update, then force-stop Folio from Settings > Apps while it is working.
Start Folio again: it should put things back as they were and say which package did not finish installing.
Folio should not offer Safe Mode just because Android closed it for memory.

items.title: Animation Speed on more motion
steps: Set Animation Speed to Slow, then open a panel, the notification shade, a switch and a segmented control, and drag an icon stack open.
They should all slow down together. Set it to Fast or Off: they should speed up or stop moving, and nothing should end up in the wrong place.

items.title: The two first-use hints
steps: Only on a phone that has just been through setup: Home should say once to press and hold an icon to rearrange.
Unfolded for the first time, it should say once that this is the same Home with more room.
Neither should come back after it has been shown once.

items.title: Bottom of Home
steps: Switch between Search bar, Page dots and Nothing.
Home should not shift between them.
With Nothing, drag along the empty strip: it should still change pages.

items.title: Stronger rings
steps: Turn on Stronger rings with a ring glyph and look at the Side Bar on the cover and the inner screen.
Try a light and a dark wallpaper.
Turn on Android's Bold text: it should turn on by itself, and off again.

items.title: Rows under a widget
steps: Put a widget at the top of a page.
The rows below it should have the same spacing as the rest, and the dock should line up with them.
Look on the cover, the inner screen and half folded.

items.title: Focus that turns on by itself
items.where: Settings > Focus > a Focus > Also Turn On When
steps: Turn on Charging for a Focus and plug the phone in: the Focus should turn on and say why.
Unplug it: the Focus should turn off.
Plug in again, turn the Focus off yourself and leave it plugged in: it should stay off.
If your phone stops charging at a limit (Samsung's battery protection), plug it in anyway: the Focus should still turn on.
Turn on a different Focus yourself, then plug in: the one you chose should stay on.

items.title: Full-Width Home, centered
items.where: Settings > Home Screen & Dock > Layout > Full-Width Home
steps: Turn on Full-Width Home: the apps should sit in the middle, with the same space on each side.
Make Space between columns smaller and the icons smaller: the apps should stay centered.
Open the App Library: it should have the same margin on the left and the right.

items.title: Drag the dock
items.where: Edit Home, with the dock on the Side Bar
steps: Drag the handle under the dock up and down.
Fold or unfold while editing: the handle should still move the dock.

items.title: Folders you can shape
steps: Drop an app on another to make a folder, then drop a third onto the folder: it should go in, and the folder should lift a little while you hold it there.
Open the folder, hold an app and drag it past the card's edge: the folder steps aside and you carry the icon to any cell, another page (hold at the screen's edge) or the dock.
Take out the last companion and the folder should go away. Drag the folder's corner to resize it, and try Sort A to Z in its options.
Try it on the cover and the inner screen.

items.title: Make the Big Clock your own
steps: Choose Customize: try a Look (Stacked too), a color, and Fine tune with its 12 or 24-hour choice.
Reset should put the clock back exactly as it was.
Choose Place Freely: drag the clock, or nudge it with the arrows, then Apply. Snap to Grid puts it back, and over apps it should refuse.
Close and reopen Folio: the clock should stay where you put it.

items.title: The Market keeps itself current
steps: Nothing should be on to start with.
The first time the Market opens, it asks once to keep packages up to date.
Turn on Refresh in the background and Tell me about updates, and see whether Android asks to show notices.

items.title: Updated recently and Undo
steps: After a package updates by itself, it should be listed under Updated recently.
Undo should put the earlier version back and leave Home as it is.
A package's own page has an Update automatically switch.

items.title: Safe Mode and the Market
steps: With Safe Mode on, background refresh and automatic updates should do nothing.

items.title: Installing an app
steps: Install or update an app from Play while Home is open: only that app's icon should show progress and Home should stay smooth.
Turn Wi-Fi off with the Side Bar showing: Home should stay smooth.

items.title: Smaller additions
steps: Suggestions widget: resize it from 1 x 1 to the whole grid.
Edit Icon on an app: choose your own picture.
Settings > Advanced > Diagnostics: Capabilities, Recent Activity and Copy Diagnostics.

items.title: Korean or Chinese with TalkBack
steps: With the phone in Korean or Chinese and TalkBack on, check Control Center toggles, the Market question and the notices.
Tell us about any English you still see.

items.title: The new setup (optional)
steps: Open the new setup from here. Nothing changes unless you choose something.
Look at the starting-point choices, and leave without changing anything if you like.
